 Thursday Night Football kicks off with an NFC East showdown, as the Washington Commanders visit the New York Giants.
 The Giants have a better win-loss record this season, 5-2 vs. 2-5, but the last time these teams met, it ended in a tie — this game will settle the score. Coming off a win over the Philadelphia Eagles , the Giants certainly want to keep that momentum. They're currently in the hunt for a playoff spot.
